verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Customer Agent integrates with ticketing platforms (Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, Pylon) covering chat and email, and its Pylon integration explicitly resolves tickets 'across email, live chat, and Slack' (parahelp-docs-16), plus a generic API lets you run it 'wherever you implement it' for in-app or custom channels (parahelp-docs-13, parahelp-docs-30). However, Slack appears only as an internal approval/notification channel (parahelp-docs-6, parahelp-docs-31), not confirmed as a customer-facing support channel, and there is no evidence of WhatsApp or social media channel support. Missing for 10: explicit WhatsApp integration, explicit social media channel support, and confirmation that Slack is used as a customer-facing chat channel rather than just internal approvals.
